description: This file defines the DepositAccountInterestRateChart class, representing an interest rate chart associated with a savings account, including methods for managing interest rate slabs, retrieving applicable interest rates, and referencing related entities.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChart
classes.description: Represents an interest rate chart for a savings account, including slabs and logic for calculating applicable interest rates.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a DepositAccountInterestRateChart instance from an InterestRateChart, converting slabs accordingly.

methods.name: updateChartSlabsReference
methods.description: Updates the reference of all chart slabs to this chart instance.

methods.name: setOfChartSlabs
methods.description: Returns the set of interest rate chart slabs, initializing if null.

methods.name: findChartSlab
methods.description: Finds a specific chart slab by its ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Retrieves the start date of the interest rate chart period.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves the end date of the interest rate chart period.

methods.name: savingsAccountId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the associated savings account.

methods.name: chartFields
methods.description: Returns the chart's field data including dates and grouping info.

methods.name: updateDepositAccountReference
methods.description: Sets or updates the associated savings account reference.

methods.name: getApplicableInterestRate
methods.description: Calculates and returns the applicable interest rate based on deposit amount, period, and client, considering slabs and incentives.

methods.name: isPrimaryGroupingByAmount
methods.description: Indicates whether the primary grouping is by amount.
